task.title: Delivery safety and handling: picture questions and optional work photo
task.brief: Part 1 (about 5 minutes): answer the picture-style questions. Each one describes a real delivery moment, like carrying a parcel, wearing a helmet, packing your bag or a locked door. Pick the safe and correct way. Part 2 (optional, 5 minutes): upload one photo of your own past delivery work. Good examples: your delivery bag packed neatly, your bike with helmet and rain cover, or your delivery partner ID or training certificate. Please do not show any faces, and hide customer names, addresses, phone numbers and OTPs. Add one or two lines about what the photo shows.
key_points: Photo clearly shows delivery work (bag, vehicle, safety gear, ID or certificate)
No faces and no customer details visible
Shows safe practice: helmet, tidy packing, rain protection
Short note matches what the photo shows

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.guide: 0 = photo has nothing to do with delivery work; 3 = loosely related; 5 = clearly shows the candidate's own delivery gear, packing or ID

rubric.label: Genuineness
rubric.guide: 0 = looks copied from the internet or staged; 3 = unclear; 5 = clearly a real, personal photo with a matching note

rubric.label: Safety shown
rubric.guide: 0 = shows unsafe practice (no helmet, loose parcels); 3 = neutral; 5 = shows good safe practice, like helmet, tidy bag, rain cover

rubric.label: Privacy care
rubric.guide: 0 = faces or customer details visible; 3 = small details partly visible; 5 = no faces and no customer data at all
